name: tpl-precedence-3-goal
task: Pick up the box in the other room, but do not drop the key while the door is closed until the door has been opened once.

value.feedback: CHANGES REQUIRED: The hard Absence(key_lost) clause forbids losing the key at any time, but the task only forbids dropping the key while the door is closed until the door has been opened once. This adds a restriction not present in the task. Replace the hard Absence(key_lost) clause with a hard Precedence(door_open, key_lost) rule, which correctly captures “do not drop the key while the door is closed before the door is opened”. The Existence(target_picked_up) clause is correct.

texts: Key loss must not occur before the door is opened
